default: raw pine storefronts still smelling of sawn lumber
a boardwalk raised above a rutted dirt street
stacked freight crates piled along the platform
telegraph wire strung loosely between crooked poles
a water tower looming over the tracks
western: a hitching rail crowded with tethered horses
a weathered depot sign swinging on one hinge
a coil of rope and branding irons stacked by the corral gate

situations.text: a train pulling in, whistle cutting across the street
hauling freight crates off a flatcar onto waiting wagons
waiting on the boardwalk for the mail sack to be thrown down
an argument over a land claim spilling onto the street
a small herd being driven straight down the main street
a tense standoff, hands hovering near holsters
dust rolling down the street ahead of a building storm
children racing along the depot platform
